verdict.rationale: Snowflake's own docs show Iceberg tables that combine Snowflake query semantics with external cloud storage you manage, and position them for existing data lakes you cannot or choose not to store in Snowflake. That covers the Iceberg part of the story without loading data into proprietary storage. Nothing in the pack shows querying Delta Lake tables or raw Parquet files in place; the file-related evidence (Snowpipe, COPY INTO, stages) is about loading data, which is the opposite of the story. Missing for 10: documented in-place querying of Delta tables, documented querying of Parquet files in object storage (e.g. external tables), independent hands-on corroboration of Iceberg querying.
